"""Repro for ticket: queryset raises NotSupportedError when RHS model has a
field named `filterable`."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth'],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD='django.db.models.AutoField',
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models, connection


class ProductMetaDataType(models.Model):
    label = models.CharField(max_length=255, unique=True, blank=False, null=False)
    filterable = models.BooleanField(default=False)

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'


class ProductMetaData(models.Model):
    value = models.TextField(null=False, blank=False)
    metadata_type = models.ForeignKey(
        ProductMetaDataType, null=False, blank=False, on_delete=models.CASCADE
    )

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(ProductMetaDataType)
    se.create_model(ProductMetaData)

brand = ProductMetaDataType.objects.create(label='brand', filterable=False)
ProductMetaData.objects.create(value='Dark Vador', metadata_type=brand)

# The exact call from the ticket:
qs = ProductMetaData.objects.filter(value='Dark Vador', metadata_type=brand)
print('rows:', [p.value for p in qs])
print('OK - no NotSupportedError')
